item.title: Blue Origin rocket explodes during test at Cape Canaveral
item.description: A Blue Origin rocket exploded on the launch tower in a fiery blast during a test of its engines on Thursday night, the company said.

item.title: What to know about Code Noir, a shocking French law that oversaw the slavery of 1.4 million Africans
item.description: France’s lower house has voted finally to scrub a foundational slavery-era edict from French law

item.title: With a stalemate in Ukraine and discontent at home, Putin seems ready to escalate war
item.description: President Vladimir Putin is facing a battlefield stalemate in Ukraine and growing war fatigue among Russians and appears ready to change the narrative around the conflict

item.title: Zelenskyy heads to Sweden as Ukraine touts drone expertise honed in war with Russia
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is visiting Stockholm for talks with Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson on defense cooperation
